import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    lines = content.strip().split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('-'):
            continue
        # Remove leading dash
        line = line[1:].strip()
        # Pattern: <Payer> paid $<amount> for "<description>". Owed equally by <list>.
        match = re.match(r'^(.+?) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "(.+?)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.$', line)
        if match:
            payer = match.group(1).strip()
            amount = float(match.group(2))
            description = match.group(3).strip()
            debtors_str = match.group(4).strip()
            # Split debtors by comma and "and"
            # Replace " and " with ", " then split by comma
            debtors_str = re.sub(r'\s+and\s+', ', ', debtors_str)
            debtors = [name.strip() for name in debtors_str.split(',') if name.strip()]
            expenses.append({
                'payer': payer,
                'amount': amount,
                'description': description,
                'debtors': debtors
            })
    return expenses
